clips.title: The story
paras: Dun Garok is a fortified dwarven mountain bastion situated in the southeastern heights of the Hillsbrad Foothills. Commanded by Captain Ironhill, the outpost's stalwart garrison defends regional Alliance interests and nearby operations like the Azurelode Mine against hostile encroachment. To the Forsaken of Tarren Mill, this entrenched dwarven stronghold stands as a constant military threat bordering their domain.

Carved into the craggy southeastern hills of Hillsbrad Foothills, Dun Garok stands as a heavily defended redoubt of Ironforge mountaineers and riflemen. Commanded by Captain Ironhill, the dwarves here maintain a critical defensive perimeter, shielding human settlements in Hillsbrad and securing vital operations at the Azurelode Mine. Their sturdy stone architecture and deep entrenchments provide the Alliance with an anchor against nearby threats.

Because of its close proximity to Tarren Mill, Dun Garok is viewed by the Forsaken as an intolerable intrusion on their southern border. Sylvanas Windrunner's forces loathe the presence of heavily armed dwarven troops so close to their stronghold, routinely plotting to infiltrate the fortress, break its defenses, and eliminate Captain Ironhill's garrison to secure Forsaken dominion over Hillsbrad.
